findings.title: Seed own refusal evidence independently of renderable private-text absolute TTL
findings.detail: Own boolean packet has a valid5s relative lease and authenticated own invitation expires30s after server_time. With server clock360000ms behind local, scopePrivate(...Date.now()) discards its raw invitation because expires_at is in the local past before observeRefusals sees it. Fresh genericDecline exists initially from own boolean, but after5s/offline no retainedfact exists; genericDecline disappears and no POST can be attempted while actual relative offer deadline is still valid. Zero/ahead-offset controls retain genericDecline and send one declinePOST. This independently reproduces a remaining006 availability gap, not server ACL bypass.
findings.required_fix: Validate minimal authenticated own offer/proposal/session/round metadata separately from private render payload using fresh own packet and anchored server-relative bound; preserve30s/180s caps, no extension/skew/rewind, no late first seed, explicitfalse/changedtuple/generation/clear/removal revocation. Do not restore private text, partner, accept/choice/Finish authority. Add both clock directions and degraded positive/negative regressions, actual component evidence and fresh independent round.
